messages:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — kicking off the StratusCompute joint perf run. Goal: perf/W baseline + throughput sweep (batch sizes 1,4,8,16) for 8k seq. Need kernel tuning, telemetry schema, and marketplace checklist. @sam from Stratus joining this thread.

sam (partner-stratus): excited to collaborate. We have 4x blades ready (A100-equivalent). Can grant bench account SSH + IPMI. When do you want to run?

alex (eng-ml): +1. Please share model artifacts (HF format + tokenizer). We'll run fp16, q4_int8 profiles. Also need the evaluation prompt set and seed.

elin (eng-runtime): For kernel tuning we need perf counters and build access. Can you enable perf-exporter v2 on nodes? Minimal run command for us: ```sudo ./bench-run --model ./model.pt --batch 8 --seq 8192 --profile /tmp/stratus-profile.json```

ravi (devex): I'll assemble a reproducible harness and a launcher. Drop results to s3://redwood-partner/stratus/run-4298765432/. I'll add a dashboard template for metrics.

andrew (product): We also need a short marketplace blurb and a joint announcement checklist (legal + PR sign-off). I can draft the blurb but want inputs on key numbers to highlight.

maria (partnerships): Proposed cadence: dry-run Mon 09:00 PT, kernel tune Tue-Wed, validation Thu, dataset sweep Fri. Does that work for lab ops @sam?

sam (partner-stratus): Lab ops confirmed. Dry-run Mon 09:00 PT works. I'll DM SSH creds and add bench account to ACLs. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: account bench@stratus added to group 'partners-bench' and ssh key deployed.

elin (eng-runtime): Ops notes for the runbook: enable hugepages, set ulimit -n 65536, disable SMT for kernel microbenchmarks. Will add to the runbook at https://docs.redwood/integrations/stratus-bench (draft).

alex (eng-ml): For perf/W we'll capture IPMI power samples and nvidia-smi telemetry. Two published metrics: p95 latency and tokens/sec per watt. Sample post-process: ```python compute_metrics.py --log /tmp/stratus-profile.json --power /tmp/power.csv --out s3://redwood-partner/stratus/run-4298765432/metrics.json```

ravi (devex): I'll open a PR with the harness + a CI job to replay the exact commands. Will parameterize batch/seq/model. Tagging @maria for partner comms so partners see the job steps.

sam (partner-stratus): Will share kernel patch branch and kernel logs. Do you prefer we build kernels remotely on our lab hardware or will you cross-compile?

elin (eng-runtime): Prefer in-situ builds to match toolchain and libs; cross-compile only if timetable forces it. We'll coordinate SSH keys and build accounts.

andrew (product): Quick question — do we want a 'certified' marketplace badge or start with 'validated with StratusCompute' note? Need decision before we publish tile.

maria (partnerships): Let's start with 'validated with StratusCompute' for the listing. Badge can come after a wider validation sweep. Action items: sam -> share SSH/IPMI creds and kernel branch; ravi -> bench harness + s3 layout; elin -> kernel tuning plan; alex -> model artifacts + eval set; andrew -> draft marketplace blurb. I'll send calendar invites and a short run checklist doc.

sam (partner-stratus): Sending creds and calendar invite now. Accepted. Looking forward to the dry-run.

maria (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll post the run summary + links to the S3 folder once dry-run starts. Ping me if anything blocks.
